description: Add guidance to improve section discovery, then re-discover sections. Use when sections are missing, incorrectly split, or named differently than expected. Saves the feedback as a domain-level guidance hint and immediately re-runs discovery so you can see the effect. Repeat until the section list matches your expectations.

anthropic_key.description: An Anthropic API key the user explicitly provided for this call. [sensitive — do not echo or log] Deprecated: the raw value is written verbatim to the host's session transcript. Never fill this from the environment.

anthropic_key_env.description: Optional. Only honoured when it equals the env var the user configured via AETHIS_ANTHROPIC_KEY_ENV in this MCP server's config; that configured key is used automatically, so this can be omitted. Do not guess a variable name: the server refuses any name the user did not configure.

anthropic_key_keychain.description: macOS keychain reference the user created for Aethis: either 'service:account' or just 'account' (service defaults to 'aethis-anthropic-key'). The server reads it via the `security` command at call time.

feedback.description: What was wrong and how to fix it, e.g. 'The english language and life in the UK test should be separate sections'

openai_key.description: Retired and refused: Aethis LLM tools use Anthropic models only.

sources.description: The same source documents used in the initial aethis_discover_sections call

content.description: Raw source text (same documents as the initial discover call)

name: aethis_refine_sections
